title: Orbitals
subtitle: Parametric ribbon sculpture & entangled celestial core
description: High-fidelity real-time GLSL raymarching homage to Dominikus Baur (@dominikus). Features sweeping parametric ribbon shells with architectural wireframe isolines, regular boundary bead lattices, tilted 3D orbital rings with astrolabe radial tick marks, a luminous white slicing arc, dense entangled core filament tubing, and floating black satellite orbs against warm archival paper.
